info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Borax Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Borax Recliner Detail Management API enables businesses to create and manage detailed catalog listings for Borax recliners. This API facilitates the addition of specifications, features, and pricing information, enhancing the product visibility and accessibility in your inventory. Common use cases include robust catalog management for retailers and updates by product teams looking to ensure accurate representations of their recliner offerings. The API serves developers involved in e-commerce, inventory management, and online retail platforms.

post.summary: Create new details for the Borax recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit information to create new details for a Borax recliner. Ensure all required data is provided in the request body to successfully create the details.

requestBody.description: Submits the details for a Borax recliner. This request body must contain all the necessary information regarding the recliner's specifications, pricing, and availability to effectively process the submission.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, and the response contains the requested details.

CreateCatalogBoraxReclinerDetailRequest.title: Borax Recliner Request Body

borax_recliner_id.description: The unique identifier for the Borax recliner.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person who requested the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of Borax recliners requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of a single Borax recliner.

CreateCatalogBoraxReclinerDetailRequest.description: Schema for the request body when creating a new Borax recliner operation.
